claim: Construct the exact split-real quaternionic surface period carrier, Hodge kernel and variation, and descend the supplied original order action to its exact period quotient.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The actual matrix period map M↦M(τ,1), its exact real inverse, and its exact complex kernel are constructed. The quotient takes an arbitrary specified ring representation ρ and actual subring O, retaining their identity; it does not silently substitute M₂(Z), a Jacobian, or an elliptic j-family.
obligations.justification: The actual matrix period map M↦M(τ,1), its exact real inverse, and its exact complex kernel are constructed. The quotient takes an arbitrary specified ring representation ρ and actual subring O, retaining their identity; it does not silently substitute M₂(Z), a Jacobian, or an elliptic j-family.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.constructed_input: Both matrix rows and columns range over all Fin2 indices. Every order element and every original period is covered by the equivariance and quotient-action theorems. No component or root choice is suppressed.
obligations.justification: Both matrix rows and columns range over all Fin2 indices. Every order element and every original period is covered by the equivariance and quotient-action theorems. No component or root choice is suppressed.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: Real period invertibility and transported complex structure require Im(τ)>0. Complex kernel and second-fundamental-map statements hold for every complex τ and do not claim a polarized torus at non-upper-half-plane parameters. Ring/order quotient statements need only the displayed representation and subring.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: The inverse divides by Im(τ), justified by strict positivity. Kernel rows are exactly (z_i,−z_iτ), their derivatives are (0,−z_i), and projected derivatives are−z. No scalar rescaling, square root, or210 multiplier is inserted into the Hodge or variation claims.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.constructed_input: The local variation is the actual derivative of the displayed inclusion, not an assumed Kodaira–Spencer map. Discreteness/fullness of the original order's period subgroup and positivity of its trace polarization are separate requirements not asserted here.
obligations.justification: The local variation is the actual derivative of the displayed inclusion, not an assumed Kodaira–Spencer map. Discreteness/fullness of the original order's period subgroup and positivity of its trace polarization are separate requirements not asserted here.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.constructed_input: Left matrix multiplication intertwines the real period map, commutes with the constructed complex structure and preserves the entire complex kernel. The original order's action descends through the actual additive subgroup quotient, with its map on representatives proved literally.
obligations.justification: Left matrix multiplication intertwines the real period map, commutes with the constructed complex structure and preserves the entire complex kernel. obligations.name: Identity
obligations.constructed_input: The period subgroup is O.toAddSubgroup.map(periodHom ρ τ). Each specified original order element maps to zero, and its left action preserves this same subgroup. The constructed Hodge space is the kernel of the same complexified period expression, with explicit inclusion, splitting and inverse frame.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.constructed_input: These constructions provide the period/Hodge/action prerequisite for a concrete quaternionic abelian-surface realization. They do not identify the universal PEL family, prove that the contact curve represents its moduli, or equate any period quotient with the represented Jacobian. The exact polarization/metric orientation and algebraic KS210 comparison remain open.
